items.headline: Precious metals decline as central bank hints at future monetary policy tightening.

items.story:
Gold and silver prices have fallen after the US Federal Reserve signaled a possible interest rate hike, sparking a sell-off in precious metals and other commodities. The decline in gold and silver prices was seen across major commodity markets, with traders increasingly betting on a rate hike by the Fed. This development has significant implications for investors and traders who have been closely watching the Fed's monetary policy decisions. According to market reports, gold and silver prices have been under pressure since the Fed's announcement, with traders adjusting their positions in anticipation of higher interest rates.

The recent decline in gold and silver prices is not an isolated incident, but rather part of a larger trend that has been shaped by the Fed's monetary policy decisions. Historically, interest rate hikes have led to a strengthening of the US dollar, which in turn has put downward pressure on commodity prices, including gold and silver. The Fed's decision to signal a possible rate hike has therefore been closely watched by traders and investors, who are trying to gauge the potential impact on the broader economy and financial markets. The gold and silver markets have been particularly sensitive to changes in interest rates, as higher rates can increase the opportunity cost of holding these assets.

The sell-off in gold and silver has been driven by a combination of factors, including the Fed's signal on interest rates and a strengthening US dollar. According to data, gold prices have fallen by a significant margin, while silver prices have also declined sharply. The decline in gold and silver prices has been mirrored by a fall in bitcoin prices, which have also been under pressure in recent days. Official statements from the Fed have emphasized the need to monitor inflation and adjust monetary policy accordingly, which has led traders to bet on higher interest rates in the coming months.

The decline in gold and silver prices has been met with a mixed reaction from traders and investors, with some seeing it as an opportunity to buy into the market at lower prices. However, others have expressed caution, citing the potential for further declines if the Fed does indeed raise interest rates. The impact of the decline in gold and silver prices has been felt across the commodity markets, with traders adjusting their positions in response to changing market conditions. The public has also been affected, particularly those who have invested in gold and silver as a hedge against inflation or currency fluctuations.

The decline in gold and silver prices has significant implications for the broader economy and financial markets, particularly in regions where these commodities are heavily traded. The strengthening US dollar has also had a ripple effect on other currencies, leading to a revaluation of assets and investments. The gold and silver markets are closely watched by traders and investors, who use these commodities as a benchmark for other investments. The recent decline in prices has therefore had a knock-on effect on other markets, including stocks and bonds.

As the Fed prepares to make its next monetary policy decision, traders and investors are closely watching for signs of a possible interest rate hike. The outcome of this decision will have significant implications for the gold and silver markets, as well as the broader economy and financial markets. With the US economy showing signs of growth and inflationary pressures building, the Fed may be forced to raise interest rates to keep the economy in check. Traders and investors will be watching closely for any signals from the Fed, which could lead to further declines in gold and silver prices or a rebound in the market.

items.headline: Regulator Suggests Overhaul of Margin Trading Framework to Mitigate Market Vulnerabilities
items.teaser: India's securities regulator, the Securities and Exchange Board of India, has proposed a reworking of the country's margin trading rules …
items.story:
India's securities regulator, the Securities and Exchange Board of India, has proposed a reworking of the country's margin trading rules in an effort to contain risks associated with this type of trading. The move is seen as a step towards enhancing investor protection and maintaining market stability. According to reports, the proposed changes are aimed at reducing the potential for excessive speculation and volatility in the markets. The regulator's decision to revisit the margin trading rules comes at a time when the Indian stock market has been experiencing significant fluctuations.

The concept of margin trading allows investors to borrow money from brokers to purchase securities, with the expectation of selling them at a higher price to repay the loan and pocket the profit. However, this practice also increases the risk of significant losses if the market moves in the opposite direction. In recent years, the Indian stock market has witnessed a surge in margin trading, prompting concerns about the potential risks to investors and the overall stability of the market. The regulator's proposed changes are intended to address these concerns and ensure that investors are adequately protected.

The proposed rules are expected to include stricter norms for brokers and investors engaging in margin trading, including higher margin requirements and stricter disclosure norms. The regulator is also considering introducing a framework for monitoring and controlling margin trading activities, which would enable it to respond quickly to any potential risks. According to officials, the proposed changes are based on a thorough review of the existing rules and consultations with market stakeholders. The regulator has invited comments from the public and market participants on the proposed changes, which are expected to be finalized soon.

The proposed changes to the margin trading rules have been welcomed by many market participants, who see them as a necessary step towards maintaining market stability and protecting investors. However, some brokers and investors have expressed concerns that the stricter norms could increase their costs and reduce their ability to engage in margin trading. The regulator's decision to rework the margin trading rules is also seen as part of a broader effort to strengthen regulatory oversight and enhance investor protection in the Indian stock market. The move is expected to have a positive impact on investor confidence and market stability in the long run.

The Indian stock market has been experiencing significant growth in recent years, driven by a combination of factors including a strong economy, favorable demographics, and regulatory reforms. However, the market has also been prone to volatility, with prices fluctuating sharply in response to domestic and global developments. The regulator's efforts to strengthen regulatory oversight and enhance investor protection are seen as crucial to maintaining market stability and attracting long-term investors. The proposed changes to the margin trading rules are part of a broader effort to create a more stable and investor-friendly market environment.

The regulator's decision to rework the margin trading rules is expected to be followed by a period of consultation and review, during which market stakeholders will have the opportunity to provide feedback and suggestions. The final rules are expected to be announced soon, and will be closely watched by market participants and investors. The regulator's ability to balance the need to maintain market stability with the need to facilitate investor activity will be crucial in determining the impact of the proposed changes. As the Indian stock market continues to evolve and grow, the regulator's efforts to strengthen regulatory oversight and enhance investor protection will remain a key focus area.

items.headline: Electricity Supply Crisis Emerges as Key Obstacle to Artificial Intelligence Advancements
items.teaser: As the world grapples with the increasing demand for artificial intelligence, experts are shifting their focus from critical metals to a …
items.story:
As the world grapples with the increasing demand for artificial intelligence, experts are shifting their focus from critical metals to a more pressing issue: electricity. The rapid growth of AI technology has led to a significant surge in energy consumption, with data centers and computing systems requiring vast amounts of power to operate. This has raised concerns about the ability of the global energy infrastructure to support the increasing demands of AI. The issue is no longer about accessing rare earth metals, but rather about generating and distributing enough electricity to power the complex systems that drive AI.

The rise of AI has been fueled by advances in computing power and the availability of large datasets, but it has also created new challenges for the energy sector. Historically, the focus has been on securing critical metals such as lithium, copper, and rare earth elements, which are essential for the production of AI-related hardware. However, as the demand for AI continues to grow, it has become clear that electricity is the real bottleneck. The production and distribution of electricity are critical to the operation of data centers, which are the backbone of AI systems. Without a reliable and efficient energy supply, the development and deployment of AI technology will be severely hindered.

According to experts, the energy consumption of AI systems is increasing exponentially, with some estimates suggesting that the carbon footprint of AI could surpass that of the airline industry by 2025. The production of electricity to power these systems is a major concern, with many countries struggling to generate enough energy to meet the growing demand. In the United States, for example, the Department of Energy has warned that the country's energy infrastructure is not equipped to handle the increasing demands of AI. Officials have called for increased investment in renewable energy sources and energy-efficient technologies to mitigate the impact of AI on the energy sector.

The implications of the electricity bottleneck for AI are far-reaching, with potential impacts on industries such as finance, healthcare, and transportation. Companies that rely heavily on AI, such as tech giants and financial institutions, are already feeling the effects of the energy shortage. Many are investing heavily in renewable energy sources and energy-efficient technologies to reduce their carbon footprint and mitigate the risks associated with energy scarcity. Governments are also taking steps to address the issue, with some countries implementing policies to promote the development of renewable energy sources and increase energy efficiency.

The global response to the electricity bottleneck for AI is being closely watched, as it has significant implications for the environment, the economy, and society as a whole. The shift towards renewable energy sources and energy-efficient technologies is expected to drive innovation and create new opportunities for growth and development. However, it also poses significant challenges, particularly for countries that are heavily reliant on fossil fuels. As the world continues to grapple with the challenges of AI, it is clear that the issue of electricity will be a major focus of attention in the years to come.

As the demand for AI continues to grow, experts are warning that the electricity bottleneck could have significant consequences if left unaddressed. The development of new energy technologies and the implementation of policies to promote energy efficiency will be critical to mitigating the impacts of AI on the energy sector. With the stakes high, governments, companies, and individuals are being called upon to work together to address the challenge of electricity and ensure that the benefits of AI are realized while minimizing its negative impacts on the environment and society. The coming years will be crucial in determining the course of AI development and the future of the energy sector.

items.story:
Europe is witnessing a significant resurgence in nuclear power, driven by a combination of factors including surging electricity demand from the artificial intelligence and data center boom, climate goals, and the need for energy independence. The regulatory environment is shifting in favor of nuclear power, making it an attractive option for meeting the continent's energy needs. This revival is taking place amid a backdrop of volatile global energy markets, where the demand for reliable and clean energy sources is on the rise. As a result, nuclear power is being reconsidered as a viable solution to meet the growing energy demands of European countries.

The renewed interest in nuclear power is not a new development, but rather a rekindling of a longstanding effort to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and mitigate climate change. Historically, nuclear power has been a significant contributor to Europe's energy mix, with countries like France and Belgium relying heavily on it. However, in recent years, the focus had shifted towards renewable energy sources, and nuclear power had taken a backseat. The current surge in demand for electricity from tech giants and hyperscalers has exceeded traditional grid capacities, prompting a reevaluation of nuclear power as a means to meet this demand.

According to industry experts, the demand for electricity from data centers alone is expected to increase significantly in the coming years, with some estimates suggesting a growth of up to 20% annually. To meet this demand, European countries are investing heavily in nuclear power, with several new reactors under construction and many more in the planning stages. For instance, the European Union has set a target of becoming carbon neutral by 2050, and nuclear power is expected to play a crucial role in achieving this goal. Official statements from regulatory bodies and industry leaders suggest that nuclear power is being viewed as a key component of a low-carbon energy mix.

The revival of nuclear power in Europe has been met with a mixed response from stakeholders and the public. While some have welcomed the move, citing the need for reliable and clean energy, others have raised concerns about safety and the environmental impact of nuclear power. The nuclear industry has been working to address these concerns, with a focus on developing newer, safer reactor technologies and improving waste management practices. As the demand for electricity continues to grow, it is likely that the debate around nuclear power will intensify, with proponents arguing that it is a necessary evil to meet the continent's energy needs.

The resurgence of nuclear power in Europe has significant implications for the global energy landscape. As the continent reduces its dependence on fossil fuels and shifts towards cleaner energy sources, it is likely to have a ripple effect on other regions. The growing demand for electricity from data centers and other industries is a global phenomenon, and the solutions developed in Europe are likely to be replicated elsewhere. Furthermore, the development of newer nuclear technologies is expected to have a positive impact on the environment, as it will reduce greenhouse gas emissions and mitigate climate change.

As the nuclear industry continues to evolve, it is likely that there will be significant developments in the coming years. Regulatory bodies are expected to play a crucial role in shaping the future of nuclear power, with a focus on ensuring safety and environmental sustainability. The industry is also expected to invest heavily in research and development, with a focus on developing newer, more efficient reactor technologies. As the demand for electricity continues to grow, it is likely that nuclear power will remain a key component of the global energy mix, and its development will be closely watched by stakeholders and the public alike.

items.headline: New Oil Sands Development Enters Commercial Operations After Decade-Long Pause

items.story:
International Petroleum Corp. has initiated commercial production at its Blackrod oil sands project in Alberta, marking the first new oil sands project to start production in the region in over a decade. The project, which began its first phase of production, aims to reach a daily average output of 80,000 barrels once it is fully ramped up. This development comes despite the prevailing narrative of peak oil demand, which has been a dominant theme in the energy sector over the past decade, particularly in Canada. The Blackrod project is a significant milestone for the oil sands industry, which has faced intense scrutiny due to its high energy intensity and associated emissions.

The Canadian oil sands have been at the forefront of the energy transition debate, with many arguing that the high-cost and energy-intensive nature of oil sands production makes it an unsustainable option in a low-carbon future. However, the Blackrod project's commencement of production suggests that there is still investment appetite for new oil sands projects, despite the challenges posed by the energy transition. The project's development has been closely watched by industry observers, who are keen to see how it will perform in a market that is increasingly focused on reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The oil sands industry has been working to reduce its environmental footprint, with many companies investing in technologies aimed at reducing emissions and improving efficiency.

According to industry reports, the Blackrod project has been designed to incorporate various environmental mitigation measures, including technologies aimed at reducing water usage and minimizing land disturbance. The project's operator, International Petroleum Corp., has stated that it is committed to responsible and sustainable development of the oil sands resource. The company has also highlighted the importance of the project to the local economy, noting that it will create jobs and generate revenue for the region. With a planned daily output of 80,000 barrels, the Blackrod project is expected to make a significant contribution to Canada's oil production, which has been steadily increasing in recent years.

The start of production at the Blackrod project has been met with a mixed reaction from stakeholders, with some welcoming the new investment and others expressing concerns about the project's environmental impact. Environmental groups have long argued that oil sands production is incompatible with Canada's climate goals, and the commencement of production at Blackrod is likely to reignite this debate. Meanwhile, industry supporters have hailed the project as a vote of confidence in the Canadian energy sector, which has faced significant challenges in recent years. The project's impact on the local community will also be closely watched, with many residents likely to benefit from the jobs and economic activity generated by the project.

The Blackrod project's start of production comes at a time of significant change in the global energy landscape, with many countries transitioning away from fossil fuels and towards lower-carbon energy sources. The project's development is a reminder that oil and gas will continue to play a significant role in the energy mix for the foreseeable future, despite the growing focus on renewable energy. The Canadian government has set ambitious climate targets, including a commitment to reach net-zero emissions by 2050, which will require significant reductions in greenhouse gas emissions from the oil and gas sector. The Blackrod project's environmental performance will be closely monitored, with many watching to see how it will contribute to Canada's climate goals.

As the Blackrod project ramps up to full production, attention will turn to the project's long-term viability and its potential impact on the broader energy sector. With many oil and gas companies shifting their focus towards lower-carbon energy sources, the Blackrod project's success will be closely watched by industry observers. The project's operator, International Petroleum Corp., will face significant challenges in ensuring the project's environmental sustainability, while also delivering returns to investors. As the energy transition continues to gather pace, the Blackrod project will be an important test case for the oil sands industry, which must adapt to a rapidly changing energy landscape if it is to remain viable.

items.headline: California Faults Reach Critical Threshold Amid Highest Stress Levels in Millennium.
items.teaser: Scientists have discovered that Southern California's major fault system is more stressed than at any point in the last 1,000 years, with…
items.story:
Scientists have discovered that Southern California's major fault system is more stressed than at any point in the last 1,000 years, with the Cajon Pass emerging as a critical "earthquake gate" that could determine the spread of a future rupture. The region's San Andreas and San Jacinto faults meet at the Cajon Pass, creating a complex seismic landscape that has been the focus of intense study. Researchers have been analyzing data from the area to better understand the underlying dynamics that drive earthquake activity. This newfound understanding has significant implications for the region's earthquake risk and mitigation strategies.

The discovery is particularly noteworthy given the region's history of devastating earthquakes, including the 1906 San Francisco earthquake and the 1857 Fort Tejon earthquake, both of which were magnitude 7.9 or greater. The San Andreas Fault, which runs for over 800 miles through California, is considered one of the most active and dangerous fault lines in the world. The current stress levels on the fault system are similar to those that preceded some of the region's largest historical earthquakes, highlighting the need for continued monitoring and preparedness. By studying the seismic activity in the region, scientists hope to gain a better understanding of the underlying processes that drive earthquakes.

According to the study, the Cajon Pass is a critical juncture where the San Andreas and San Jacinto faults meet, and its unique geology could play a key role in determining whether a future earthquake rupture spreads across both faults. Researchers found that the pass has a distinct "gate" effect, where the stress buildup on one fault can transfer to the other, potentially triggering a larger earthquake. The study's lead author noted that the current stress levels on the fault system are unusually high, with some areas experiencing stress levels that are 20-30% higher than average. This increased stress is a concern for scientists, as it could indicate a higher likelihood of a significant earthquake in the near future.

The discovery has sparked concern among local authorities and emergency responders, who are already working to prepare for a potential earthquake. The region's earthquake early warning system, which is designed to detect the early signs of an earthquake and provide critical seconds of warning, is being tested and refined in light of the new findings. Residents are also being encouraged to take steps to prepare for an earthquake, including securing heavy furniture and having a family emergency plan in place. As the region's population continues to grow, the need for effective earthquake mitigation and preparedness strategies has never been more pressing.

The study's findings have broader implications for our understanding of earthquake risk and mitigation, both in California and around the world. As scientists continue to refine their understanding of the complex seismic processes that drive earthquakes, they are developing new tools and strategies for predicting and preparing for these events. The discovery of the Cajon Pass as an "earthquake gate" highlights the importance of continued research and monitoring in the field of seismology. By studying the unique geology and seismic activity of different regions, scientists can develop more effective strategies for reducing the risk of earthquake damage and loss of life.

As researchers continue to study the San Andreas Fault and the Cajon Pass, they will be closely watching for signs of increased seismic activity, including small earthquakes and changes in the fault's stress levels. The US Geological Survey and other agencies will also be working to refine their earthquake forecasts and warning systems, using the latest data and research to provide critical information to the public. With the region's fault system at its highest stress levels in 1,000 years, the need for continued vigilance and preparedness has never been more urgent, and scientists will be working tirelessly to provide the public with the information they need to stay safe.

items.headline: Cervical cancer mortality rates plummet among young women following widespread HPV vaccination efforts.

items.story:
Women in England who have received the human papillomavirus vaccine have a nearly zero risk of dying from cervical cancer before the age of 30, according to recent studies. The rollout of the HPV vaccine has been highly effective in reducing the risk of cervical cancer among young women. The vaccine has been widely available in England for several years, and its impact is now being seen in the significant reduction in cervical cancer cases and deaths. As a result, no young women have died from cervical cancer in England for years, highlighting the vaccine's success.

The introduction of the HPV vaccine has been a major public health achievement, building on decades of research into the causes of cervical cancer. Human papillomavirus is a common infection that can lead to cervical cancer, and the vaccine has been shown to be highly effective in preventing the virus. The vaccine was first introduced in England several years ago, and since then, it has been routinely offered to girls in school. The vaccine's rollout has been widely supported by health professionals and campaigners, who have highlighted its potential to save thousands of lives.

Studies have shown that the HPV vaccine has cut the risk of dying from cervical cancer before 30 to almost zero. According to estimates, the vaccine has already prevented around 200 deaths in England. The vaccine's impact is expected to increase over time, as more women receive the vaccine and its effects become more widespread. Experts have welcomed the findings, saying that they demonstrate the vaccine's effectiveness in preventing cervical cancer. The results are based on data from several years of vaccine rollout and are consistent with expectations.

The reaction to the study's findings has been positive, with health professionals and campaigners praising the vaccine's success. The results have also been welcomed by families who have been affected by cervical cancer. The study's findings are expected to inform future public health policy, with a focus on maintaining high vaccine uptake rates and ensuring that all eligible girls receive the vaccine. The vaccine's impact is also expected to be felt in other countries, where it has been introduced as part of national immunization programs.

The success of the HPV vaccine in England has implications for global health efforts to prevent cervical cancer. The vaccine has been introduced in many countries, and its impact is being closely monitored. The World Health Organization has set a goal of eliminating cervical cancer worldwide, and the HPV vaccine is seen as a key tool in achieving this goal. The vaccine's effectiveness in preventing cervical cancer has also highlighted the importance of vaccination programs in preventing infectious diseases.

As the HPV vaccine continues to be rolled out around the world, health professionals will be closely monitoring its impact and looking for ways to improve vaccine uptake rates. The study's findings are expected to inform future research into the vaccine's effects and its potential to prevent other types of cancer. With the vaccine's success in England, there is now a growing focus on maintaining high vaccine uptake rates and ensuring that all eligible girls receive the vaccine, in order to build on the progress that has been made so far.

items.headline: Maritime restrictions eased outside the Strait of Hormuz following major diplomatic breakthrough.
items.teaser: The United States has lifted its maritime blockades outside the Strait of Hormuz, following a recently brokered peace deal in the region.…
items.story:
The United States has lifted its maritime blockades outside the Strait of Hormuz, following a recently brokered peace deal in the region. This move is expected to significantly ease tensions in the area, which is a critical waterway for international oil trade. The blockades had been in place for several months, causing concerns among shipowners and oil traders about the safety of their vessels and the potential for disruptions to global energy supplies. The US decision to lift the blockades is seen as a major confidence-building measure, aimed at supporting the peace process and promoting stability in the region.

The Strait of Hormuz has long been a source of contention between the US and Iran, with both countries having significant interests in the area. The waterway is a vital shipping lane, with a large proportion of the world's oil passing through it every day. In recent years, there have been several incidents of ships being seized or attacked in the area, leading to a significant increase in tensions between the US and Iran. The blockades imposed by the US were aimed at preventing Iranian ships from entering the area, but they also had the effect of restricting the movement of other vessels and causing concerns among regional and global stakeholders.

According to US officials, the decision to lift the blockades was made in consultation with regional partners and is intended to support the implementation of the peace deal. The officials stated that the US will continue to monitor the situation in the area and take all necessary measures to protect its interests and ensure the safe passage of ships. The peace deal, which was brokered by a third-party mediator, aims to resolve longstanding disputes between the US and Iran and promote greater cooperation and stability in the region. Experts say that the lifting of the blockades is a significant step forward, but caution that much work remains to be done to fully implement the peace deal and address the underlying issues.

The lifting of the blockades has been welcomed by shipowners and oil traders, who had been concerned about the safety of their vessels and the potential for disruptions to global energy supplies. The move is also expected to have a positive impact on the global economy, as it will help to reduce tensions and promote greater stability in the region. However, some stakeholders have expressed caution, noting that the situation in the area remains complex and that there are still many challenges to be addressed. The US decision to lift the blockades has also been seen as a significant diplomatic victory for the third-party mediator, which had been working to broker a peace deal for several months.

The lifting of the blockades outside the Strait of Hormuz is part of a broader effort to promote greater stability and cooperation in the region. In recent months, there have been several significant developments, including the signing of a new security agreement between the US and several regional partners. The agreement aims to promote greater cooperation on issues such as counter-terrorism and maritime security, and is seen as an important step forward in promoting greater stability in the region. Experts say that the lifting of the blockades and the signing of the security agreement are significant developments, but note that much work remains to be done to fully address the underlying issues and promote lasting peace and stability in the area.

As the situation in the region continues to evolve, stakeholders will be watching closely to see how the peace deal is implemented and whether the lifting of the blockades will lead to a lasting reduction in tensions. The US and its regional partners will need to continue to work together to address the underlying issues and promote greater cooperation and stability in the area. The international community will also be watching to see how the situation develops, and whether the peace deal will have a positive impact on the global economy and regional stability. With many challenges still to be addressed, the coming months will be critical in determining the success of the peace deal and the future of the region.

items.story: ആമസോൺ പ്രൈം ഡേ 2026 സെയിൽ ജൂലൈ 4 മുതൽ 6 വരെ നടക്കും. പത്താം വാർഷികാഘോഷത്തിന്റെ ഭാഗമായി എസ്ബിഐ, ആക്സിസ് ബാങ്ക് കാർഡുകൾക്ക് 10% കിഴിവ്, പ്രൈം അംഗത്വ ഫീസിൽ ഇളവ്, 500-ൽ അധികം പുതിയ ഉൽപ്പന്നങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയുണ്ടാകും. എക്കോ, ഫയർ ടിവി പോലുള്ള ആമസോൺ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾക്കും വലിയ വിലക്കിഴിവ് പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.

items.story: ജോലി തേടി തിരുപ്പൂരിലെത്തിയ മലയാളി യുവതിക്കു നേരെ ലൈംഗികാതിക്രമം; ലോറി ഡ്രൈവർ അറസ്റ്റിൽ Manorama Onlineതിരുപ്പൂരിൽ ജോലി വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്ത് മലയാളി യുവതിക്ക് നേരെ ലൈംഗികാതിക്രമം; ലോറി ഡ്രൈവർ അറസ്റ്റിൽ Suprabhaathamതിരുപ്പൂരില്‍ ജോലി തേടി എത്തിയ മലയാളി യുവതിക്ക് നേരെ ലൈംഗികാതിക്രമ ശ്രമം; ലോറി ഡ്രൈവര്‍ അറസ്റ്റില്‍ Marunadan Malayaliജോലി വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്ത് മലയാളി യുവതിയെ പീഡിപ്പിക്കാൻ ശ്രമിച്ച ലോറി ഡ്രൈവർ ഫൈസൽ അഹമ്മദ് പിടിയിൽ Janmabhumi
